The drinks were amazing as well, and the staff were all incredibly sweet and welcoming throughout the evening. The only issue we had was with one dish we ordered that never arrived. We asked about it twice and were told they would check on it, but it still didn’t come, so we ended up ordering another plate of sushi while we waited.

Thankfully, the missing dish wasn’t added to our bill, so no complaints there. It was a small hiccup, and I’d just suggest being a bit more mindful with orders, but apart from that everything was lovely.

The food we did receive was great, the atmosphere was stunning, and overall it was a really enjoyable dining experience.

featured_reviews.name: Shreya Bharti
featured_reviews.review_text:
Being a lover of spicy Asian food, I was quite excited to try out Wok Express. And it didn't disappoint! Their delicious wok boxes, dumplings and chicken wings are just few of the dishes on the menu that you absolutely have to try.
What we had:

Asian Vegetable Soup (Chicken): Served in thermocol cup. Warm, flavourful and full of veggies. Bit on the spicy side. Loved it!

Lemon Coriander Soup: It was not the usual, bland ones you find. Still delicious. Quantity was quite filling for one.

Assorted Vegetable Dumplings: Your usual mix veggie dimsums or momos. 5 pieces on a bed of spicy schezwan sauce which was heavenly in taste. Trust me, the sauce was finger-licking good!

Aromatic Chicken Dumplings: Recommended! The schezwan sauce was honestly one of the best I've tasted and went so well with those juicy dumplings. Must try!

Chicken Wings: We tried 2 pieces each of all the three different choices of sauce, namely
Asian - sweet and spicy (4/5)
Schezwan - spicy and BEST out of all (5/5)
Indonesian Sweet n Sour - TOO much ketchup. Too sweet. Avoid. (2/5)

Fish Peri Peri: Soft fish chunks cooked in peri peri gravy along with greens. Personally, did not like it much. Quantity is huge so order carefully (we ordered half portion).

Hot Crispy Garlic with Ramen Noodles (chicken): This wok box is one of the chef's recommendations and must try. High on spice level. Personal size wok serves enough quantity for 1 person.

Customized Wok Box: There is an option to customize the wok box according to your likes! You can choose your own base, veggies, sauce and condiments. We ordered flat wheat noodles with onion, carrot, pepper mix and button mushroom in Bangkok Street Style fiery sauce and burnt garlic, fried onion and chilli flakes as condiments. It was clearly a winner! Loved the flat wheat noodles more over the ramen ones. RECOMMENDED!

Mango Basil Bubble Tea and Lemon Iced Tea: Both the drinks were really refreshing and great for summers. However, do order them WITHOUT the bubbles, that is, the tapioca pearls that are optional. They were an absolute mood killer.

Very Berry Strawberry Icecream: They outsource their icecreams from Baskin Robbins. Loved the sweet berry flavour after all that spicy food, haha :p

Fortune Cookie: A fun little cookie with a message for you.

Overall, I liked my experience here and would definitely come back for its flat wheat wok box, soups and dumplings. The ambience is not much since it's a QSR (quick service restaurant). Slightly over priced I felt. They're great with deliveries though, having flawless packaging. Happy eating!
#AllWoksOfLife

featured_reviews.name: Meera Wadher
featured_reviews.review_text:
A really decent place for delicious indo-chinese cuisine! They have great quantity & quality of food! A must-try. Ordered spring rolls and a Veg Steak Sizzler, it was sufficient for 3-4 people. Glad to have found this place, pretty underrated + affordable + provides great service. There's some waiting time during weekends, but it's worth it because the food is amazing :)

They don't serve sizzlers on Sundays, so if you're going to try that, go on weekdays/Saturday instead!

Noodles -
They do have an amazing variety of noodles, btw. Tried their veg fried rice, veg hakka noodles and Phad Thai Phak Noodles. The Thai noodles tasted great, had different veggies and an exotic flavor...yummm!

Brownie -
I'm not much of a dessert person, but once I tried their sizzling walnut chocolate brownie, I changed my mind. Loved how the roasted walnut pieces blended in with the scoop of vanilla ice cream🤍

review_photos.caption: This is a bowl of half-eaten Phad Thai Phak Noodles, so the quantity is more than this. Basically, full to the brim.

featured_reviews.name: Sagar Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text: We recently visited for dinner with friends and, though we had to wait over half an hour, we were looking forward to a good time together. Upon entering, we were informed that our seating would be separate, which was disappointing as we wanted to enjoy the evening as a group of 8. After some discussion with the staff, they managed to arrange seating for us together, which we appreciated. The food, however, made up for any earlier issues. We started with Chinese bhel, which had a delightful crunch and unique flavors. The Sanjhi special sizzler was a highlight, full of vibrant taste and satisfying portions. Fried rice was well-prepared, and we ended with a warm brownie that hit the spot. The food was delicious, and we all left feeling happy and satisfied, ultimately making the evening a success despite the initial hiccup. Would recommend for the food, but it might help to check on seating arrangements ahead of time!

Quantity is really good here, usually one dish being enough for two people easily. To add to that, their food is at a very reasonable price. Service is prompt and even though the staff are not highly trained, they do get the job done. We had the following to eat :
Chicken Sweet Corn Soup - Large pieces of perfectly cooked chicken in a thick soup consisting of egg and sweet corn, it felt really good in this cold weather.

featured_reviews.review_text: Food is good, especially the tawa items but they tend to use too much oil, and also the mutton kheema tends to have pieces of bones in it. Simple dishes like a Thai green curry or even a Chicken Tandoori full that I ordered were mindblowingly spicy for anyone's liking. featured_reviews.name: Hozefa Topiwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Flavours of China at Prabhadevi recently and had a pleasant experience overall. First things first – parking is quite a challenge in this area, so it’s better to plan ahead or park in lanes nearby.

The restaurant is small and simple, not a fancy place, but clean and decently maintained. What truly makes it stand out is the hospitality of the staff. From helping us with menu recommendations to being attentive throughout the meal, the service was impressive. They made sure no plate was left empty and were quick to respond whenever we needed something.

Coming to the food – everything was freshly prepared, served piping hot, and packed with flavor. The portion sizes were generous, making it great value for money.

If you’re looking for a no-frills Chinese dining experience with great service and delicious food, Flavours of China is worth a visit.

featured_reviews.name: rajesh jaiswar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Flavours Of China in Prabhadevi is a solid go-to spot for Indo-Chinese and Thai cuisine, especially if you’re looking for tasty food at reasonable pricing in the South Mumbai area.

🍽️ Food:
The food is definitely the highlight here. Their menu offers a wide variety—from classic Chinese gravies and noodles to Thai curries and rice. Dishes like burnt garlic rice, Manchurian, and Thai curries stand out for their bold flavours and generous portions. The taste is consistent, slightly on the Indianised side (which most people prefer), and perfect for comfort dining. Many customers also appreciate the freshness and customizable options available.

🥢 Portion Size & Value:
Portions are quite generous, making it ideal for sharing. Pricing is pocket-friendly for the quality and quantity offered, making it a great value-for-money option in the area.

🏠 Ambience:
The ambience is simple and casual—not a fine dining place, but clean and comfortable for a quick meal with friends or family. Seating space is slightly limited, so it can feel a bit cramped during peak hours.

🧑‍🍳 Service:
Service is generally quick, especially for takeaway and delivery orders. However, during busy hours, there can be slight delays and service could be more attentive.

📍 Location:
Conveniently located in Prabhadevi near Century Bazaar, it’s easily accessible and a popular neighbourhood dining spot.

⸻

✅ Pros:

* Delicious Indo-Chinese flavours
* Generous portion sizes
* Good value for money
* Wide menu variety (Chinese + Thai)

featured_reviews.name: Swapnil Rane
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing and unacceptable experience at FOC.

The chicken served to us was clearly stale and did not seem fresh at all. This is not just about poor food quality — it is a serious health concern. Serving stale food can directly impact an individual’s health, and such negligence is unacceptable from any restaurant.

What made the experience even worse was the response from the staff. Even after we immediately informed them about the issue, there was no sincere apology, accountability, or effort to address the concern properly. Instead, the focus seemed to be elsewhere without understanding the seriousness of the matter.

To be clear, this is not about asking for a discount or compensation. Customer health and food safety should always be the top priority. A simple acknowledgment and genuine apology would have been the bare minimum.

Very disappointed with the lack of responsibility and professionalism. Definitely not the kind of experience one expects.
